OFFICE OF THE REGIONAL DIRECTOR
MAILING ADDRESS P.O. BOX 13716 PHILADELPHIA, PENNSYLVANIA, 19101
Mr. Theodore R. Robb
Regional Administrator
Department of Housing and Urban

Curtis Building

Dear Mr. Robb:
I have reviewed your draft environmental statement concerning the Randolph Urban Renewal Project and in my opinion the construction of this project will not have a significant adverse impact on the environment. Therefore, we concur with the statement.
Thank you for the opportunity to review and comment on this statement.
Sincerely yours,
John E. McKenna
Regional Environmental
Goordinator
RICHTOND, VA.
